name: Destroy Sarcophagus
brief: Overload a damaged stasis crypt while tomb systems attempt to repair it.
objective: Accumulate 20 Destruction points on the sarcophagus.

startingNpos.deployment: Wholly within NPO territory. Put half, rounding down, in the sarcophagus room and spread the remainder across the other rooms.

rules.name: Sarcophagus
rules.summary: Treat C1 as an objective marker. When Breach Sarcophagus is performed within its control range, the Guide automatically rolls 2D6 and adds the total as Destruction points instead of applying normal Breach effects.

rules.name: Nanoscarab Repair
rules.timing: Ready step of each Strategy phase
rules.summary: During the Ready step, tell the Guide how many player operatives control the sarcophagus. The Guide automatically rolls D6, subtracts 1 for each of those operatives, and removes that many Destruction points, to a minimum of 0.

victory.win: The sarcophagus has 20 or more Destruction points.

setupChecks.label: Arrange the killzone as shown on the Mission 4 map and identify the Player drop zone and NPO territory.
Identify the C1 sarcophagus shown on the mission map as the mission objective marker.

The Guide automatically generates the D3+6 starting NPO roster. Set those NPOs up wholly within NPO territory: place half, rounding down, in the sarcophagus room and spread the remainder across the other rooms.
Start with 2CP total and select up to four equipment options, recording and managing both for tabletop play; the Guide does not track or validate their effects.
